title: Dr. Saeed-ur-Rahman Presents Scholarly Work to Vice Chancellor of AWKUM
text:
Dr. Saeed-ur-Rahman, Assistant Professor in the Department of Islamic Studies at Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan (AWKUM), formally presented his book titled
“Tahqeeq'at-e-Islamiyat Advanced (Urdu Islamic Research Theses Index)”
to Prof. Dr. Muhammad Jamil, Vice Chancellor of the university, during an official meeting.
The book represents a significant academic contribution to the field of Islamic studies, offering a comprehensive index of Urdu research theses that will serve as a valuable resource for scholars, researchers, and students alike.
During the meeting, Prof. Dr. Muhammad Jamil appreciated Dr. Saeed-ur-Rahman’s scholarly efforts and highlighted the importance of such works in strengthening research culture and academic excellence within the university.
The occasion marked a notable milestone in promoting advanced Islamic research and underscored AWKUM’s commitment to supporting intellectual and academic development.
